Title: Set up environment and portfolio repo
Body: Set up Python env (conda/venv), create ai-portfolio GitHub repo with README stub, create Kaggle account. Skim current ML Engineer vs MLOps vs AI Engineer vs Data Scientist job postings to calibrate expectations.

Title: Linear algebra refresher
Body: Watch 3Blue1Brown Essence of Linear Algebra series. Build: implement basic matrix operations in NumPy from scratch.

Title: Calculus refresher and gradient descent
Body: Watch 3Blue1Brown Essence of Calculus. Build: implement gradient descent from scratch on a toy function.

Title: Linear regression from scratch
Body: Andrew Ng ML Specialization Course 1 (regression, cost functions). Build: linear regression from scratch (NumPy only) on a housing dataset.

Title: Logistic regression and classification
Body: Andrew Ng ML Specialization Course 2 (classification, regularization). Build: logistic regression from scratch, then redo both regression models with scikit-learn.

Title: Trees ensembles and feature engineering
Body: Andrew Ng ML Specialization Course 3 (trees, ensembles, eval metrics). Build: train XGBoost/Random Forest on Kaggle Titanic, focusing on feature engineering (DE skill transfer). Add data validation checks for the dataset.

Title: Phase 1 wrap-up
Body: Review and fill any gaps. Write up Phase 1 project on GitHub with a clean README.

Title: Neural networks basics
Body: DL Specialization: Neural Networks Basics. Build: neural net from scratch (no framework) for MNIST.

Title: PyTorch fundamentals
Body: DL Specialization: Improving DNNs. Build: rebuild MNIST model in PyTorch.

Title: Experiment tracking setup
Body: DL Specialization: Structuring ML Projects. Build: set up Weights and Biases experiment tracking on the MNIST project.

Title: Convolutional neural networks
Body: DL Specialization: CNNs. Build: build CNN for CIFAR-10 in PyTorch.

Title: Transfer learning project
Body: Learn transfer learning concepts. Build: fine-tune pretrained ResNet on a custom image dataset.

Title: Sequence models overview
Body: DL Specialization: Sequence Models (RNN/LSTM overview, mostly historical context now).

Title: Buffer and catch-up
Body: Catch-up week. Polish CIFAR-10 and transfer learning project for portfolio.

Title: Phase 2 wrap-up
Body: Review. Write up Phase 2 projects on GitHub.

Title: Transformer architecture
Body: Read Jay Alammar's The Illustrated Transformer.

Title: Build a mini-GPT
Body: Watch Karpathy's Let's Build GPT. Build: follow along and build a mini-GPT from scratch.

Title: Fine-tune an open-source LLM
Body: Hugging Face transformers docs and course. Build: fine-tune a small open-source LLM with LoRA on a custom dataset.

Title: Vector databases and embeddings
Body: Learn vector database and embeddings concepts. Build: set up Chroma or Weaviate, generate embeddings for a document set.

Title: Build a RAG pipeline
Body: Learn RAG architecture patterns. Build: build a basic RAG pipeline (LangChain or plain Python) over your own documents.

Title: Agent and tool-use basics
Body: Learn agent/tool-use concepts (function calling, agentic loops). Build: extend RAG app with a simple tool-calling agent.

Title: Buffer and catch-up
Body: Catch-up week. Polish RAG and agent project.

Title: Phase 3 wrap-up
Body: Review. Write up Phase 3 project on GitHub - this is often the strongest AI Engineer portfolio piece.

Title: Model serving with FastAPI
Body: Learn model serving basics (FastAPI). Build: wrap a trained model in a FastAPI endpoint.

Title: Containerize the model service
Body: Learn containerization for ML. Build: Dockerize the FastAPI model service.

Title: Feature store setup
Body: Learn feature stores (Feast). Build: set up Feast for one of your earlier projects.

Title: Orchestrated ML pipeline
Body: Learn ML pipeline orchestration (Kubeflow/Vertex AI Pipelines or Airflow-for-ML). Build: build an orchestrated pipeline - ingest, validate, train, evaluate, register.

Title: Model registry with MLflow
Body: Learn model registries and versioning (MLflow). Build: register model versions in MLflow, log experiments.

Title: Monitoring and drift detection
Body: Learn monitoring and drift detection concepts. Build: add logging/monitoring to deployed model, e.g. Evidently AI for drift.

Title: Deploy the full pipeline
Body: Deploy the full pipeline to Render/Fly.io/AWS free tier.

Title: Capstone finalization
Body: Buffer/catch-up week. Finalize as the capstone project.

Title: Capstone documentation and blog post
Body: Finalize capstone README (architecture diagram, decisions, tradeoffs). Write one blog post explaining the full pipeline.

Title: Resume and LinkedIn rewrite
Body: Resume rewrite with ML/AI positioning. Update LinkedIn headline and summary.

Title: Start applying and networking
Body: Start applying to ML Engineer / MLOps Engineer / AI Engineer roles. Begin warm outreach to people in target roles/companies.

Title: Interview prep and continued applications
Body: Continue applying. Review ML fundamentals, practice system design for ML, do mock interviews.
